cards.meaning: it cannot be denied that / admittedly (concede a valid point before pivoting to a rebuttal)
cards.example: 不可否认，今年七月Anthropic和OpenAI的收入都超过了预期，但支撑这一切的杠杆非常脆弱。
cards.examplePinyin: Bùkě fǒurèn, jīnnián qīyuè Anthropic hé OpenAI de shōurù dōu chāoguòle yùqī, dàn zhīchēng zhè yīqiè de gànggǎn fēicháng cuìruò.
cards.exampleMeaning: It cannot be denied that Anthropic and OpenAI both beat their revenue targets in July, but the leverage underneath it all is extremely fragile.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register — common in editorials, research notes, and scripted anchor delivery; the spoken-register equivalent is simply 确实 or 说实话. Specifically structures a 'concede, then rebut' move — unlike 显然 (obviously), which just states a fact with no concessive implication.
cards.tiesTo: Op-Eds & Commentary — Wallace-Wells/Sarin's NYT piece on AI as both real technology and real financial bubble

cards.meaning: to seize the first-mover advantage (grab a favorable position before competitors can react)
cards.example: Google在长时储能这个赛道上抢占先机，提前锁定了最好的供应商。
cards.examplePinyin: Google zài chángshí chǔnéng zhège sàidào shàng qiǎngzhàn xiānjī, tíqián suǒdìngle zuì hǎo de gōngyìngshāng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Google is seizing the first-mover advantage in the long-duration-storage race, locking up the best suppliers ahead of time.
cards.note: A common business-Chinese collocation — 抢占 pairs just as naturally with 市场 (market) or 份额 (share). Distinct from a neutral phrase like 提前准备 (prepare in advance): 抢占先机 carries a competitive, exclusive edge — once a rival seizes the position, it's gone for everyone else.
cards.tiesTo: Deep Dive — Google's right-of-first-refusal lockups with Form Energy and Energy Dome in the LDES race

cards.meaning: accountability, liability (answerable for consequences before the law or an authority, not just a duty in name)
cards.example: Idineklara ng COA na may pananagutan si Bise Presidente Duterte sa 73 milyong pisong hindi wastong paggastos.
cards.exampleMeaning: The COA declared that Vice President Duterte has liability for 73 million pesos in improperly spent funds.
cards.note: Stronger than the plain word for duty, responsibilidad — pananagutan implies real consequences if the obligation isn't met, such as a legal proceeding, not just an unmet role or task.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines — Day 16 of the Duterte impeachment trial, the first hard peso liability figure

cards.meaning: coercion, applying sustained pressure to force compliance (a strategy, not just a single statement)
cards.example: Nag-panggigipit umano ang embahada ng Tsina sa pamamagitan ng banta ng pag-aresto sa mga OFW.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Chinese embassy allegedly engaged in coercive pressure through the threat of arresting OFWs.
cards.note: Distinct from banta (already taught) — banta is the threat itself, the specific statement made; panggigipit is the broader campaign of ongoing pressure that a threat is often just one tool within.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines — the Chinese Embassy's threat to arrest Filipino workers over the Sanjia-Steel dispute
